answer.reason: Beyond the lists and building instructions, the verses tell of its setting up, of Uzziah's leprosy beside it, and of the angel who appeared by it to Zacharias.

clauses.english: was set before the veil in the tent, and sweet incense was burnt on it
clauses.quote: he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail

clauses.english: was where King Uzziah was struck with leprosy for trying to burn incense
clauses.quote: the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests

clauses.english: was where an angel appeared to Zacharias with news of a son
clauses.quote: an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense

doubts: Most marked verses only list it among the furnishings or give its measurements, and the materials are already in the summary, so they were left out.
LUK 1:11 and 2CH 26 are not marked, but they are the verses that tell what happened at the altar.
